result.summary: The page layout is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation shows the wrong tab as active for the displayed home feed.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights Profile in green while the screen content is the home/discovery feed (delivery address, search, categories, and restaurant lists). The active tab state does not match the current page.
issues.suggestion: Set Home as the active tab on this screen, and only highlight Profile when the user is actually on the profile page.
